title: Understanding Model Variance
text: Model variance refers to how much the model's predictions would change if we used a different training dataset. Adding a new feature can increase the complexity of the model, which might affect variance.

title: Effect of Adding a Squared Feature
text: When you add a squared feature, it can increase the model's flexibility, allowing it to fit the training data more closely. This can lead to an increase in variance.
